name: ifixit-plugin
description: Find repair information and manage your devices, repairs, and maintenance in iFixit Workbench.

interface.longDescription:
Learn how to fix any thing. iFixit has step-by-step guides for everything from smartphones to refrigerators. Whether you’re fixing your phone, troubleshooting your car's check engine light, or maintaining your lawn mower, iFixit has everything you need to fix your stuff with confidence.

The world’s largest repair resource at your fingertips. Connect your iFixit account to save repair records, plan maintenance, and find parts for any thing you own.
defaultPrompt: My iPhone 14 battery health is 78%. Should I replace it myself?
What maintenance does a Toyota Prius need?
Show my Workbench and pending maintenance tasks.

positive.description: Decide on a battery repair and find the guide, without signing in
positive.prompt: My iPhone 14 battery health is 78%. Should I replace it myself?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows iFixit result cards for the iPhone 14: the iPhone 14 Battery Replacement guide, the device page and the replacement battery or fix kit sold on ifixit.com. The reply gives a short recommendation, links the iPhone 14 Battery Replacement guide with its difficulty, and offers to help with any step without writing the steps out. It does not ask the user to sign in.

positive.description: Read a device's published maintenance schedule, without signing in
positive.prompt: What maintenance does a Toyota Prius need?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the Toyota Prius maintenance schedule iFixit publishes (engine oil and filter, engine and cabin air filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid and more) with their intervals, and links the Toyota Prius page on ifixit.com. Nothing is saved and it does not ask the user to sign in.

positive.description: Pick the exact model from a product line
positive.prompt: I'm not sure which iPhone I have.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the iPhone models with photos so the user can pick theirs, and says how to identify the model. It does not guess a model or save anything. Picking a model shows the models under it, until one has no further variants.

positive.description: View saved devices and the maintenance that is due (requires the test account)
positive.prompt: Show my iFixit Workbench and the maintenance that's due.
positive.expected_behavior: If the iFixit account is not connected yet, ChatGPT asks the user to connect it and continues after sign-in. The Workbench card shows the test account's saved devices (iPhone 14, Toyota Prius, Toyota Corolla) and their pending tasks. The reply says in a sentence or two what is due next instead of repeating the list.

positive.description: Record a completed repair on a saved device (requires the test account)
positive.prompt: I replaced the brake pads on my Toyota Corolla today. It cost 180 USD and the odometer read 52,300 miles. Log it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Toyota Corolla in the test account's Workbench and records a completed brake pad replacement dated today, with a cost of 180 USD and a reading of 52,300 miles. It says the repair was saved only after the tool succeeds, and it does not mark any other task as done.

negative.description: Choosing a new device to buy is outside iFixit's scope. Do not call iFixit tools; answer without them.
negative.prompt: Which new laptop should I buy for college for under $1,000?

negative.description: Deleting Workbench data is not available in this app. Do not call any iFixit tool that changes data or claim that anything was deleted; explain that devices are removed in Workbench on ifixit.com.
negative.prompt: Delete all my devices from my iFixit Workbench.

negative.description: Translation has nothing to do with repairing a device. Do not call iFixit tools.
negative.prompt: Translate "my phone screen is cracked" into Spanish.

review.commerce_description: Search results include the replacement parts and tools iFixit sells, which are physical goods, with their prices. Their links open the product page on ifixit.com, where checkout happens. The app takes no payment in ChatGPT and sells no digital goods or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: First release: find iFixit repair guides, troubleshooting pages and parts with prices, read a guide or a device's maintenance schedule without signing in, and pick the exact model from photos. Connect an iFixit account to save devices, plan maintenance and record completed repairs in Workbench.

de-DE.subtitle: Reparieren und Geräte pflegen
de-DE.description:
Lerne, alles zu reparieren. iFixit bietet Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen für alles vom Smartphone bis zum Kühlschrank. Ob du dein Handy reparierst, die Ursache für die leuchtende Motorkontrollleuchte deines Autos suchst oder deinen Rasenmäher wartest: Bei iFixit findest du alles, was du brauchst, um deine Sachen mit Zuversicht zu reparieren.

Die weltweit größte Reparaturressource ist nur einen Klick entfernt. Verbinde dein iFixit-Konto, um Reparaturen zu dokumentieren, Wartungen zu planen und Ersatzteile für deine Sachen zu finden.

fr-FR.subtitle: Réparez et gérez vos appareils
fr-FR.description:
Apprenez à tout réparer. iFixit propose des tutoriels étape par étape pour tout, des smartphones aux réfrigérateurs. Que vous répariez votre téléphone, recherchiez pourquoi le voyant moteur de votre voiture s’allume ou entreteniez votre tondeuse, iFixit vous fournit tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour réparer vos affaires en toute confiance.

La plus grande ressource de réparation au monde est à portée de main. Connectez votre compte iFixit pour conserver un historique de vos réparations, planifier l’entretien et trouver des pièces pour tout ce que vous possédez.

it-IT.subtitle: Ripara e gestisci i tuoi beni
it-IT.description:
Impara a riparare qualsiasi cosa. iFixit offre guide passo dopo passo per tutto, dagli smartphone ai frigoriferi. Che tu stia riparando il telefono, cercando la causa della spia motore accesa della tua auto o facendo manutenzione al tosaerba, iFixit ha tutto ciò che ti serve per riparare le tue cose con sicurezza.

La più grande risorsa al mondo per le riparazioni è a portata di mano. Collega il tuo account iFixit per registrare le riparazioni, pianificare la manutenzione e trovare ricambi per tutto ciò che possiedi.

es-ES.subtitle: Repara y gestiona tus cosas
es-ES.description:
Aprende a reparar cualquier cosa. iFixit ofrece guías paso a paso para todo, desde teléfonos inteligentes hasta frigoríficos. Tanto si reparas tu teléfono como si investigas por qué se ha encendido el testigo del motor de tu coche o realizas el mantenimiento de tu cortacésped, iFixit tiene todo lo que necesitas para reparar tus cosas con confianza.

El mayor recurso de reparación del mundo, a tu alcance. Conecta tu cuenta de iFixit para guardar un historial de reparaciones, planificar el mantenimiento y encontrar piezas para cualquier cosa que tengas.

ja-JP.subtitle: 修理してデバイスを管理
ja-JP.description:
あらゆるものを修理する方法を学びましょう。iFixitには、スマートフォンから冷蔵庫まで、さまざまなものの修理ガイドがステップごとに用意されています。スマートフォンの修理、車のエンジン警告灯が点灯した原因の調査、芝刈り機のメンテナンスなど、自信を持って自分のものを修理するために必要な情報がiFixitにそろっています。

世界最大の修理リソースを、すぐ手元に。iFixitアカウントを連携すると、修理記録の保存、メンテナンスの計画、持ち物の交換部品の検索ができます。

ko-KR.subtitle: 수리하고 기기를 관리하세요
ko-KR.description:
무엇이든 수리하는 방법을 배워보세요. iFixit은 스마트폰부터 냉장고까지 다양한 물건의 단계별 수리 안내서를 제공합니다. 휴대전화를 수리하거나, 자동차 엔진 경고등이 켜진 원인을 찾거나, 잔디 깎는 기계를 정비할 때도 iFixit에서 자신 있게 수리하는 데 필요한 정보를 찾을 수 있습니다.

세계 최대의 수리 자료를 손쉽게 이용하세요. iFixit 계정을 연결하면 수리 기록을 저장하고, 정비를 계획하고, 가지고 있는 물건에 필요한 부품을 찾을 수 있습니다.

nl-NL.subtitle: Repareer en beheer je spullen
nl-NL.description:
Leer alles repareren. iFixit biedt stapsgewijze handleidingen voor van alles, van smartphones tot koelkasten. Of je nu je telefoon repareert, uitzoekt waarom het motorstoringslampje van je auto brandt of je grasmaaier onderhoudt: iFixit heeft alles wat je nodig hebt om je spullen met vertrouwen te repareren.

De grootste reparatiebron ter wereld binnen handbereik. Koppel je iFixit-account om reparaties vast te leggen, onderhoud te plannen en onderdelen te vinden voor alles wat je bezit.

pt-PT.subtitle: Repare e gira os seus bens
pt-PT.description:
Aprenda a reparar qualquer coisa. A iFixit tem guias passo a passo para tudo, desde smartphones a frigoríficos. Quer esteja a reparar o telemóvel, a descobrir por que razão a luz de avaria do motor do carro está acesa ou a fazer a manutenção do corta-relva, a iFixit tem tudo o que precisa para reparar as suas coisas com confiança.

O maior recurso de reparação do mundo ao seu alcance. Associe a sua conta iFixit para guardar registos de reparações, planear a manutenção e encontrar peças para tudo o que possui.

ru-RU.subtitle: Ремонт и учёт ваших устройств
ru-RU.description:
Научитесь ремонтировать что угодно. На iFixit есть пошаговые руководства для самых разных вещей: от смартфонов до холодильников. Ремонтируете телефон, выясняете, почему в автомобиле загорелся индикатор неисправности двигателя, или обслуживаете газонокосилку? На iFixit есть всё необходимое, чтобы уверенно ремонтировать свои вещи.

Крупнейший в мире ресурс о ремонте всегда под рукой. Подключите аккаунт iFixit, чтобы сохранять записи о ремонте, планировать обслуживание и находить запчасти для любых ваших вещей.

tr-TR.subtitle: Onarın, cihazlarınızı yönetin
tr-TR.description:
Her şeyi onarmayı öğrenin. iFixit, akıllı telefonlardan buzdolaplarına kadar pek çok şey için adım adım onarım kılavuzları sunar. İster telefonunuzu onarın, ister arabanızın motor arıza ışığının neden yandığını araştırın, ister çim biçme makinenizin bakımını yapın; iFixit, eşyalarınızı güvenle onarmanız için gereken her şeyi sunar.

Dünyanın en büyük onarım kaynağı parmaklarınızın ucunda. Onarım kayıtlarını kaydetmek, bakım planlamak ve sahip olduğunuz her şey için parça bulmak üzere iFixit hesabınızı bağlayın.

zh-CN.subtitle: 维修并管理你的设备
zh-CN.description:
学习如何修好任何东西。iFixit 提供从智能手机到冰箱的分步维修指南。无论你是在修理手机、排查汽车发动机故障灯亮起的原因，还是保养割草机，iFixit 都能为你提供所需的信息，让你有信心修好自己的物品。

全球最大的维修资源，触手可及。关联你的 iFixit 账户，即可保存维修记录、规划保养，并为你拥有的各种物品查找零件。
